title: Echo-Vision-FM: a pre-training and fine-tuning framework for echocardiogram video vision foundation model
core_idea: Develop a self-supervised framework that pre-trains a video encoder on large-scale unlabeled echocardiogram videos using a high-ratio masked auto-encoding strategy, and enhance the learned representations with a spatial-temporal fusion network (STF-Net) that integrates spatial and temporal correlations to produce robust, transferable video representations for downstream echocardiogram tasks without requiring manual annotations or intermediate segmentation.
tldr: A scalable pre-training and fine-tuning approach that learns robust echocardiogram video representations from unlabeled data via masked auto-encoding and a spatial-temporal fusion network to enable end-to-end, annotation-efficient cardiac analysis across tasks and institutions.
